sources.entry: subarr | Coordination layer beside Bazarr and subgen: calibrated audio-language detection, library-wide subtitle coverage, and a queue UI for Whisper transcription.

summary.one_liner: subarr is a coordination layer beside Bazarr and subgen that finds which media files truly lack subtitles, verifies audio language, and queues Whisper transcription through a web UI.
summary.what_it_does: Subarr walks your Sonarr/Radarr/Bazarr library and reports per-language subtitle coverage, only treating a file as a gap after it has actually probed the file. It runs calibrated audio-language detection by sampling three Whisper chunks across each file and voting, and flags mislabeled or bilingual tracks for manual review. It queues transcription jobs to subgen through a backpressured queue with pause, reorder, requeue and cancel, and tracks which provider supplied each subtitle. It also offers a Tuning Lab that sweeps Whisper recipes against a live subgen, post-transcription Aftercare quality review, automatic re-timing, and Plex and Jellyfin library refresh after a subtitle lands. Authentication is on by default, and multiple libraries and separate Sonarr/Bazarr stacks are supported.
use_cases: fill missing subtitles across a multi-language library
detect the real spoken language of anime or dubbed files
queue Whisper transcription through a web UI
review and fix wrong audio-language tags
track which Bazarr provider supplied each subtitle
refresh Plex or Jellyfin after new subtitles land
tune Whisper settings per language on local hardware
how_to_run: Copy docker-compose.yml from the repo (compose.yaml example uses image ghcr.io/coaxk/subarr:latest)
Mount a persistent volume for /data (SUBARR_DB_PATH=/data/subarr.db) and your media at the same path Bazarr and subgen see
Open the onboarding wizard in the browser on port 9922 to auto-detect Sonarr, Radarr, Bazarr, Tautulli and subgen
notable: Probe-gate: only files subarr has verified appear as gaps; unprobed files wait in an Analyzing bucket
Calibrated audio-language detection: three Whisper chunks at 10/50/90 percent of the file, majority vote, confidence is the minimum across agreeing chunks
Tuning Lab sweeps Whisper recipes against live subgen and ranks them per language
Multiple libraries and multiple Sonarr/Radarr/Bazarr instances with writeback routed to the owning instance
Non-root container with hardened capability-drop deployment option
caveats: Full feature set needs the custom ghcr.io/coaxk/subarr-subgen image; vanilla mccloud/subgen runs in a reduced compat mode
Single-admin authentication only, no per-user accounts or roles; SQLite only, single host, no Emby support
Whisper writes one subtitle language per job (English in translate mode), so some wanted languages cannot be produced; Logs page needs Docker socket access
